text_to_speech: here's how to make your logo spin click on the video on the timeline and make sure the cursor is positioned where you want the spin to start click on the effect controls tab at the top then click on the effects tab on the bottom click the video effects drop down menu and under perspective you'll see basic 3d drag the effect up and drop it into the effect controls click the circle next to swivel drag the cursor to the end of the clip and then back and effect controls change the swivel value to 360 if you want the spin to loop simply copy and paste the clip if this video was helpful please drop a like and subscribe to the channel it helps me a bunch and stay tuned for more videos that help content creators everyday [Music]

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Here's how to make your logo spin. Click on the video in the timeline and make
sure the cursor is positioned where you want the spin to start. Click on the
Effect Controls tab at the top. Then click on the Effects tab on the bottom.
Click the Video Effects drop-down menu and under perspective you'll see basic
3D. Drag the effect up and drop it into the Effect Controls. Click the circle
next to swivel. Drag the cursor to the end of the clip and then back in
Effect Controls change the swivel value to 360. If you want to spin to loop
simply copy and paste the clip. If this video was helpful please drop a like
and subscribe to the channel. It helps me a bunch and stay tuned for more
videos that help content creators every day.
